admission.justification: Prevents delivering another role’s operative duties or silently omitting applicable shared instructions.

applicability: Operation-root instruction blocks compiled for one selected role and applicable operation.
conditions: Common passages and passages addressed to that role are delivered; excluded passages are not delivered.
Malformed recipient declarations anywhere in sections-mode source refuse before delivery; the delivered-content seal retains original source revisions.
exclusions: No grant of another role’s duties or tool permissions.
Unsectioned all-audience blocks retain their declared whole-body semantics.
statement: The compiler delivers the selected role plus only common and explicitly addressed stage instructions, refusing invalid audience declarations before delivery.
